result.instructions: Tools for Hobok, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still open, and what is their total?"; "Issue an invoice to customer 12 for 3 hours of consulting at 800 SEK, due in 30 days."; "Mark invoice 2026-0042 as paid by Swish today.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hobok data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hobok_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hobok_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hobok_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. hobok_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hobok_get_me
tools.title: Get the connected hobby business
tools.description: Show the hobby business this API key is bound to, the plan, the next invoice number, the payment terms and the currency. GET /v1/me.

tools.name: hobok_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: List the payment method values that hobok_mark_invoice_paid accepts. Each value is in Swedish and is printed on the receipt. GET /v1/payment-methods.

tools.name: hobok_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally by status (sent, paid, credited). Each invoice has its number, buyer, lines, totals and dates. GET /v1/invoices.

tools.name: hobok_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice with its lines, totals, status and emails sent. GET /v1/invoices/{local_id}.

local_id.description: The invoice's local_id, as returned by hobok_list_invoices or hobok_create_invoice.

tools.name: hobok_create_invoice
tools.title: Issue an invoice
tools.description: Issue an invoice with status sent. It takes the next invoice number, which cannot be reused. Give client_id for a saved customer, or buyer for a one-off buyer, not both. VAT is always 0. The invoice is emailed only when send_email is true. POST /v1/invoices with an Idempotency-Key. Retrying the same request with the same key does not issue a second invoice. Two separate invoices with the same content need different idempotency_key values, or the second call returns the first invoice. A network or timeout error does not say whether the record was saved: list the records first before you retry.

client_id.description: Id of an existing customer (from hobok_list_clients).

buyer.description: A one-off buyer, copied onto the invoice. Use either this or client_id, not both.

issue_date.description: Issue date yyyy-mm-dd (default: today, set by Hobok).

due_date.description: Due date yyyy-mm-dd. Default: issue date plus the account's payment terms.

our_reference.description: Your reference, printed on the invoice.

their_reference.description: The buyer's reference, printed on the invoice.

vat_rate.description: Only 0 is accepted. Any other value is rejected.

send_email.description: Email the invoice to the buyer now. Default false. A sent email cannot be recalled; set true only when the user asks.

email_message.description: Plain-text email body. Used only when send_email is true.

idempotency_key.description: Your own key for this request. Retrying with the same key returns the first answer. If you omit it, the server derives one from the request.

tools.name: hobok_mark_invoice_paid
tools.title: Mark an invoice paid
tools.description: Record that a sent invoice was paid. Hobok creates the receipt and books the income for the year. Only a sent invoice can be marked paid; any other status returns 409. POST /v1/invoices/{local_id}/mark-paid with an Idempotency-Key. Use hobok_list_payment_methods for payment_method values. A network or timeout error does not say whether the record was saved: list the records first before you retry.

local_id.description: The invoice's local_id, as returned by hobok_list_invoices or hobok_create_invoice.

payment_date.description: Payment date yyyy-mm-dd (default: today, set by Hobok).

payment_reference.description: Payment reference, e.g. a bank reference or OCR number.

send_receipt_email.description: Email the receipt to the buyer. Default false. A sent email cannot be recalled; set true only when the user asks.

idempotency_key.description: Your own key for this request. Retrying with the same key returns the first answer. If you omit it, the server derives one from the request.

tools.name: hobok_email_receipt
tools.title: Email a receipt
tools.description: Queue the payment receipt of a paid invoice for delivery to the buyer. A 200 means queued, not delivered. The API has no idempotency key here: a retry can send the receipt twice, so check hobok_get_invoice first. POST /v1/invoices/{local_id}/receipt/email.

local_id.description: The invoice's local_id, as returned by hobok_list_invoices or hobok_create_invoice.

tools.name: hobok_list_clients
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the saved customers of the hobby business. Use an id from this list as client_id in hobok_create_invoice. GET /v1/clients.

tools.name: hobok_create_client
tools.title: Add a customer
tools.description: Add a saved customer with a name and optional address and contact fields. POST /v1/clients. Hobok documents no idempotency key here. A network or timeout error does not say whether the record was saved: list the records first before you retry.

tools.name: hobok_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the saved products and services of the hobby business, with their prices. GET /v1/products.

tools.name: hobok_create_product
tools.title: Add a product
tools.description: Add a saved product or service with its price in SEK. POST /v1/products. Hobok documents no idempotency key here. A network or timeout error does not say whether the record was saved: list the records first before you retry.

unit_price.description: Price per unit in SEK. Required.

prompts.title: Get started with Hobok
prompts.description: What you can do with Hobok here, with example requests to try.
